description: Metal-conditioning ablation on the 24 h probe cohort under the ligand-disjoint leave-one-metal-out protocol, with the in-house D-MPNN (migration of BLK-PA15 off the chemprop v2 reference).  Four arms (none / token / desc / film) share cohort, split and seeds; a paired bootstrap over the 5 metals x 5 seeds cells tests whether an explicit metal input recovers cross-metal transfer.
model: MetalAwareDMPNN, hidden=128 depth=3 dropout=0.1, epochs=50, zero-shot (no adaptation)

protocol.cohort: MetalCytotoxDataset + CytotoxFilter(24h, ic50>=0.01uM) + collapse_duplicates, per metal
protocol.split: leave-one-metal-out, ligand-disjoint (held-out metal's ligands dropped from the train pool)
protocol.significance: paired bootstrap over 25 (metal, seed) cells, 10000 resamples, seed 42; Holm-Bonferroni over the 3 conditioned arms

holm.correction: Holm-Bonferroni (family = 3 conditioned arms vs the same baseline)

chemprop_reference.note: chemprop v2 is a REFERENCE scorer here, not the paper's model (project red line: the predictive line is the in-house D-MPNN).

verdict: CONDITIONING DOES NOT RECOVER THE COLLAPSE: the best arm (desc) moves cross-metal AUC by +0.0235 (paired bootstrap 95% CI [-0.0036, +0.0521], Holm p=0.1362); the cross-metal collapse is intrinsic to the metal axis, not an artefact of an unconditioned scorer.
caveats: The in-house `token` arm concatenates the projected metal VECTOR (18-d base metal features: identity + oxidation state + charge) at the readout — the closest in-house analogue of chemprop's learnable metal token.

The `desc` arm adds the transferable descriptor blocks (--rich-metal + --chem-metal).  The chem-metal block is all-zero if molmetal/data/metal_chemistry_5.csv is absent, in which case the arm degenerates to token.
Rh (n=51), Os (n=36) and Re (n=74) test folds are small; per-metal deltas on those cells carry large variance.
Capacity is NOT matched to the chemprop reference (128 vs 300); the comparison is reported as a scorer/representation result.
The in-house model is bit-reproducible on CPU (OMP_NUM_THREADS=1), so the 5-seed spread here reflects split/init variance, not run nondeterminism.
honest_framing_note: Every number is MEASURED from the four ex1 arm reports on disk; the verdict and contributes_method flag are derived from the bootstrap CI and the Holm-adjusted p, not asserted.
